title: How to Get FREE Water for Your Garden in Los Angeles
description:
Get FREE recycled water for your Los Angeles garden, lawn, and plants! The Los Angeles Department of Water and Power offers this program to help residents save money. You can collect up to 300 gallons of non-potable water per visit to keep your landscape green during times of water scarcity.

Recycled water is perfect for irrigating trees, lawns, and vegetables. However, it is not safe for drinking or washing food. Simply bring your water bill to the fill station to complete a quick training session and start saving.

Visit the LA-Glendale Water Reclamation Plant on Fridays from 8:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. to receive quick training and start watering for free.

To learn more, visit: LADWP.com/RWFS
